message: hermes compile: "V_lib" carries a Go runtime but is not in the g* namespace. Rename it to glibhermesnet.a (or gnet.a) so the target gate can see it; all Go-runtime libraries must start with 'g'.
why: The g* prefix is a declaration, not a heuristic scan of file contents: the compiler is entitled to treat every g* library as Go-runtime-bearing, and that naming is the only thing the bare-metal gate reads. A Go archive without the prefix is invisible to the gate, so it can walk a Go runtime into firmware — and the run time would die from the missing OS, not from a build error.
fix: rename the archive to glibhermesnet.a (or gnet.a) and rebuild the plan
if it is really a pure C/Rust library, do not occupy the g* namespace — both sides of the contract are declarations, not scans
